text:
tess_reynolds: Quick sync on autoscale card — compact layout shows burst chip overlapping steppers at narrow widths and the min value gets clipped. Need ideas to keep controls visible without increasing card height.

 mike_choi: Suggestion: anchor controls to a fixed bottom row using grid (top: title/meta, bottom: controls). Keeps visual alignment in lists. Also right-align burst chip so it doesn't collide.

 dana_ops: Accessibility: if we anchor, DOM order must be logical. Ensure stepper buttons have clear aria-labels (e.g., 'Increase max GPUs') and 44px touch targets. Add aria-live for burst state changes.

 ravi_kumar: UX tradeoff: anchoring is good, but in very dense lists single-line titles may be preferred (ellipsis + tooltip). Could offer two density modes: compact (single-line) and comfortable (wrap + pinned controls).

 tess_reynolds: For SLO slider, we should show bucket labels by default (Fast / Balanced / Cheap) and reveal ms value on drag or hover. Microcopy under slider: 'Lower latency increases cost. Balanced is recommended for steady traffic.'

 mike_choi: Implementation note: set .stepper { min-width: 88px } for compact variant so numbers don't collapse. Use CSS grid to reserve bottom space.

 dana_ops: Copy tweak: 'Min kept warm' and 'Max autoscale' instead of just Min/Max helps clarity. Also make burst chip copy explicit: 'Burst +2 GPUs' or 'Burst off' when inactive.

 tess_reynolds: Decision: 1) pin control row, 2) right-align burst chip, 3) show buckets with ms tooltip, 4) provide density toggle. Approve?

 ravi_kumar: Approve.

 design-bot: Reminder: attach updated figma and tag ticket with ui-autoscale-compact and a11y-review.

 tess_reynolds: Action items: update mocks for both density modes, add tooltip copy, and handoff to engineering for CSS prototype. I'll post new frames by Thursday.

 dana_ops: I'll run a quick aXe pass when mocks are in.

 tess_reynolds: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
